title: Review A-List artists
description: Use the administration review queue, request information, approve an artist and confirm access revocation.

steps.caption: 1. Administration starts with community tasks and the number of pending artist reviews.
2. Review A-List applications opens the searchable queue, with pending submissions first.
3. Read the artist's identity, experience, scene and social profiles before deciding.
4. Add a clear message. Request information lets the artist update and resubmit.

target.label: Message to artist (required when requesting information)

actions.value: Thanks for sharing your scene and radio experience.

steps.caption: 5. Approve grants A-List access and records your decision in the artist's history.
6. Revocation requires confirmation. Cancel leaves the artist's access unchanged.
